dom.scope: Report DOM uses short image URIs; all full original embedded PNGs are separately verified byte-for-byte. No full report browser-layout or native Manager UI claim.

privacy: No machine-specific configuration, user paths, literal session tokens or personal run store is included. Source and the decompressed bundled Python code are checked separately; exact contents are fixed by archive manifests.
limitations: No clean-machine installation test; existing models and installed CUDA were reused.

Only the small cudart package was transferred from NVIDIA in the recorded download check; model, engine and cuBLAS transfer paths use the same checked downloader and pinned metadata, with local HTTP failure/resume tests.
The packaged server and worker were tested through authenticated HTTP and their program controller, not by clicking the native Manager buttons.
Optional external launch wrappers are supported only by the source route; the Windows package is qualified for its direct bundled worker.
Worker timing is a functional observation, not an additional quality or speed benchmark.
No independent review or full offline report layout validation.
Report DOM uses short image URIs in the fixture; every full embedded original PNG is separately checked. No full standalone report browser layout QA.

publication_preflight.standalone_links: External references use absolute links; images, scripts, both report languages and complete guides are embedded.
publication_preflight.future_release_links: Additional RU/EN reports use fixed v0.1.0-preview asset names; initial assets are retained unchanged.
